text.en: Thiruvalluvar guides us on virtue, thought and life.

The last selection of kurals gives guidance on virtue and wise living. Thirukkural has 1330 couplets in 133 chapters.
The couplets are short and universal, and each can guide a decision in life. Learn them with their meanings.
Revise all selected kurals with their chapter names and meanings, and practise writing each in your own words.
